notes.title: New game - “Under the blue horizon - Aquarium” will be free for owned players
notes.content:
We noticed a lot of feedback from people who played our game that they would like to see more idle and fish not die. We wanted to create a smaller version of that game using our existing assets, and the structure of the game changed a lot during development, so we diversified into two different games. Today we revealed the release schedule for the smaller game.

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3197730/Under_the_blue_horizon__Aquarium/]https://store.steampowered.com/app/3197730/Under_the_blue_horizon__Aquarium/[/url]

Our new game - "Under the blue horizon - Aquarium" will be free for players who own "Under the blue horizon"
We are currently exploring ways to apply that discount.

We will also be updating Under the blue horizon with bug fixes before we release that content.
Thank you for your patience. Thank you all for your continued support and enjoyment of our game.
